name: El Dueloroso
author: Adrián JG; Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
description: El Dueloroso by Adrián JG, a western-themed arcade shooting game for the Game Boy (Game Boy Competition 2021): 15 levels, 3 game modes, 4 difficulty levels, original music and high scores saved on the cartridge. GPL-3.0 (github.com/ajgalan/el-dueloroso).

descriptions.en: El Dueloroso by Adrián JG, a western-themed arcade shooting game for the Game Boy (Game Boy Competition 2021): 15 levels, 3 game modes, 4 difficulty levels, original music and high scores saved on the cartridge. GPL-3.0 (github.com/ajgalan/el-dueloroso).
descriptions.it: El Dueloroso di Adrián JG, un gioco arcade di sparatorie a tema western per Game Boy (Game Boy Competition 2021): 15 livelli, 3 modalità, 4 livelli di difficoltà, musiche originali e record salvati sulla cartuccia. GPL-3.0 (github.com/ajgalan/el-dueloroso).
